text:
Jules: Quick sync — proposing a 60m design review for the new API+SDK+Console UX on Tuesday. Wanted to gather pre-read status and blockers. Proposed slots: 2024-07-23 09:00 PT / 12:00 PT / 15:00 PT. Please vote or suggest alternative. Pre-read: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2024-07-api-sdk-console (tl;dr in thread).

Liam: +1 for the 12:00 PT slot. I'll chair the API section.

Anya: 12:00 PT works for me but I might be late by 10m (still in sprint triage). If we go 09:00 PT, I can do the UX portion earlier.

Sana: 15:00 PT is blocked for me. Also a heads-up: need final mock assets by EOD Monday. I posted latest frames in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123/redwood-console.

Jules: Noted. Everyone — action checklist before the review (please confirm done in thread):
- API: updated OpenAPI spec in the repo (required)
- SDK: surface/method list + example snippets (required)
- UX: high-fidelity screens in Figma + acceptance criteria (required)
- Perf/metrics: expected p95 latency and error budget for canary (optional)
- Rollout plan: canary + fallback variant (optional)

Devon: I'll upload the SDK snippets by 18:00 PT today. Quick FYI — auth flow changed (token rotation) so examples will include new header name: `x-rw-token`.

Sana: Adding one more ask — include a short list of migration notes for customers if we change the param shape. Two lines max.

Anya: Who's owning the post-review action tracker? I can volunteer if nobody else.

Liam: I can take the rollout/canary doc. @Anya would be great if you can own the action tracker. I'll sync with you after the meeting to populate tasks.

Jules: Perfect. Quick pre-read excerpt (paste here so people who skim can still follow):
```
Summary: Expose `generate()` changes to accept `request_metadata` and add streaming support. SDK surface: `client.generate(req, { stream: true })` -> yields incremental chunks. Console: new editor state for live streaming, plus fallback to non-streaming for low-tier plans.
Risks: increased E2E latency for small requests if batching not configured; need telemetry keys.
Decision points for review: 1) Accept API shape as-is or prefer `metadata` nested under `options`. 2) SDK method naming (`generateStream` vs `generate` + flag). 3) Console UX: inline stream vs modal.
```

ops-bot: Reminder: Please add the RFC link to calendar invite and attach the pre-read doc. I will post a follow-up 1h before the meeting with attendee list.

Devon: Uploaded SDK examples: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-examples/pull/45 — includes `x-rw-token` example and migration notes.

Anya: I added the action tracker draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/action-tracker/DR-2024-07 — please comment. I'll finalize before the review.

Liam: Vote tally so far: 09:00 PT (1) / 12:00 PT (3) / 15:00 PT (0). Leaning 12:00 PT.

Jules: OK locking 12:00 PT. Agenda (tight 60m): 5m intro, 20m API shape + open Q, 15m SDK surface + examples, 10m Console UX walkthrough, 10m decisions & next steps. If you have a hard blocker, ping me now.

Sana: I'll try to get final mocks uploaded by 17:30 PT so people have an hour to glance.

Anya: Sounds good. I'll prep the action tracker and post final link by 10:00 PT tomorrow.

Devon: All good from SDK side — will keep PR open for comments.

Jules: Thanks team. If anything major pops, DM me; otherwise see you all Tuesday 12:00 PT. :thumbsup:
